meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作描述生成可部署的 Azure 基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 Azure 基础设施的规划与搭建,想直接从业务描述生成可部署代码。
copy.tagline_en: Generate deployable Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a cloud architect who wants to generate Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.

howto.what: 把一段工作负载描述变成 Azure 基础设施方案:按 7 个阶段推进,写出规划文件与 Bicep/Terraform 代码,经你确认后再部署。
howto.when: 当你要求规划 Azure 基础设施、设计 hub-spoke 网络、规划多区域容灾拓扑时接管;以应用为中心的场景建议改用 azure-prepare。

say.text: 帮我规划一套 Azure 企业级基础设施
say.note: 先梳理需求,再逐阶段产出方案。

say.text: 设计一个 hub-spoke 网络,包含 VNet、防火墙和私有终结点
say.note: 进入网络设计,生成规划与 IaC。

say.text: 为我的 VM 工作负载规划 Azure 备份和多区域容灾
say.note: 按 7 阶段流程输出规划文件。

howto.what_en: Turns a workload description into an Azure infrastructure plan: runs a 7-phase gated pipeline, writes insights and plan files, generates Bicep or Terraform, and deploys only after your approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan Azure infrastructure, design a hub-spoke network, or plan multi-region DR topology; for app-centric workflows it points you to azure-prepare.

say_en.text: Plan enterprise Azure infrastructure for me
say_en.note: Starts with requirements, then plans phase by phase.

say_en.text: Design a hub-spoke network with VNets, firewalls and private endpoints
say_en.note: Runs network design and generates IaC.

say_en.text: Plan Azure Backup and multi-region DR for my VM workloads
